tables.title: Moves
rows: Two lunging headbutts open its melee combo. Each one is marked by a stab indicator、hits a narrow 60-degree cone in front of it、so stepping to the side works better than backing away.

The third hit of the combo comes after roughly two 秒onds of windup. It's a slam that hits everything near it for 35 with heavy knockback、then scatters 30 earth mines around the boss、so get clear during the windup、stay out until the mines pop.

Each mine explodes one 秒ond after it appears、launching you straight up for 5 damage (3 at the edge of the blast). One is trivial、but the stomp drops 30 at once、every Earth outbreak rock leaves a trail of them.

Its horns change color、then it slams one fist、then the other about a 秒ond apart. Each slam sends a ring of magma rolling outward that hits for 22、inflicts Burned、so jump over each ring、since a dodge roll won't carry you through it.

It tracks you for about two 秒onds、then launches three rocks along the ground in a 40-degree fan. Each hits for 18、inflicts Burned、knocks you back、and leaves earth mines in its path、so sidestep late、don't run down the trail.
Below 80% health、whenever its 28-second cooldown is ready、it moves to the arena center、comes apart、and the next swap pulls it back into armor. It can't be staggered while it transforms.

After about two 秒onds of charging、it fires three to five soul beams that rotate around it for 12 秒onds、deal 7 soul damage every tenth of a 秒ond to anything inside one. Keep moving with the rotation rather than trying to cross a beam.

It fires rings of 13 orbs in every direction、roughly two rings a 秒ond for 11 秒onds、and each orb hits for 10. The gaps between orbs widen with distance、so slipping through is easier at range than up close.

A gravity well drags you toward it while pulses of force contract inward、and after about seven 秒onds it detonates for 90 soul damage up close、8 farther out、with massive knockback. Jump or roll through each pulse、spend the pull walking out of range、and don't count on Evasion、which doesn't work against the blast.
